notes: Stage 7/Phase 3 rules are adapted to the package-extracted structure.
Legacy lib/services files have been removed; UI-facing compatibility facades now live under lib/providers/controllers.

forbidden.reason: Core utilities must stay dependency-light and feature-neutral.
Domain models may be impure during Stage 1, but they must not depend on app features.
Persistence code must not depend on presentation or platform UI glue.
Presentation controllers expose behavior to providers/UI; they must not import widgets or screens.
Platform wrappers should stay narrow and composable.
Crypto primitives must not depend on application, transport, storage, platform, or presentation code.
Protocol definitions and codecs must stay reusable outside transport and UI.
Screens and widgets should not talk directly to transport internals.
